problem_type: Canvas chrome popover rendered in place inside a low stacking context instead of the global overlay layer; fixed-width row layout with nowrap on both columns
symptom: 2026-09-21 real-app walkthrough (canvas-handles-alt-drag, zh-CN screenshot 09): opening the canvas controls help (keyboard button, bottom-left) showed a panel half covered by the floating Agent input dock and the batch-generate bar. In the English UI the 'Box select (adds to selection)' action text overlapped its 'Shift + drag' keycap.
direct_cause: CanvasControlsHelpPopover rendered its panel with `absolute bottom-[calc(100%+8px)] ... z-[12]` inside CanvasNavigationStack, whose container is `z-[8]`; any sibling chrome above z-8 (Agent collapsed dock z-40, batch dock z-9) painted over it regardless of the inner z-12. Each row was `flex justify-between` with `whitespace-nowrap` on the action text and on the keycap inside a fixed w-[30rem] two-column grid, so a long translated action had no way to wrap and ran under the keycap.
class_root: The panel chose its own layer (a local z-index) instead of using the design-system owner of 'what is on top' (src/design/overlayLayers.ts via AnchoredPopover). A local z-index can only order siblings inside the same stacking context, so the result depends on whoever else happens to be mounted at the bottom of the workspace. The 2026-08-08 fix for the same panel widened it (w-96 -> w-[30rem]) and re-centered it: it tuned the symptom for the strings of that day instead of letting the text column wrap.
affected_population: Every user opening canvas controls help while the Agent panel is collapsed (floating input dock) or while the batch-generate bar is visible
English (and any longer-string locale) users reading the help panel
entry_points: Canvas navigation stack keyboard button (CanvasNavigationStack -> CanvasControlsHelpPopover)

external_sources.purpose: A z-index inside a stacking context never paints above content outside that context; portal to the root layer is the standard fix.
tldraw renders its shortcuts help as a portal dialog on the top UI layer, not inside the toolbar that opens it.

invariants: The canvas controls help panel renders through AnchoredPopover (portal to body, overlayLayers.popover z-index, viewport flip/clamp); it never positions itself inside the navigation stack.
Each help row is a two-column grid: the action column may wrap (minmax(0,1fr), min-w-0), the keycap column never wraps; a long action grows the row, never overlaps the keycap.

door_reduction.why_not: CanvasNavigationStack mounts the help popover, the popover now reads the shared AnchoredPopover, and AnchoredPopover owns the layer (only its consumer note changed). Three different responsibilities, nothing to merge.

generality_proof: The layer is no longer a per-component number: AnchoredPopover takes it from overlayLayers.popover (9200), above every canvas chrome tier and below dialogs/confirmations, so any future bottom chrome cannot cover it. The walkthrough measures reach (49/49 elementFromPoint samples owned by the panel) and per-row overlap in zh-CN and en, with the Agent panel open and collapsed, with and without the batch bar, at 1280x900 and at the 1100x720 window minimum.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Portal + global popover layer + viewport placement for anchored rich-content popovers.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Moved onto AnchoredPopover; structure test forbids in-place absolute and local z-index; walkthrough reach 49/49 in 8 layouts x 2 locales.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: model / concurrency selects in the batch bar
same_class_entry_points.evidence: They open through NomiSelect / WorkbenchMenu (Radix portal), not in place.
No popover; it is itself bottom chrome.

recurrence.reason: Second report on the same panel (2026-08-08 overflow, 2026-09-21 covered + overlap); each new bottom chrome or longer locale string would re-break an in-place, fixed-width panel.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs AnchoredPopover: 7 read doors, help panel is now one of them
rg 'bottom-\[calc\(100%' src/workbench/generationCanvas/components: only the old help panel (removed)

prevention.invariant: Help panel uses AnchoredPopover, carries no local z-index, and its action column may wrap.
prevention.failure_mode: Restoring the in-place absolute panel, a local z-[n], or nowrap on the action text turns canvasControlsStructure.test.ts red; the walkthrough's reach and row-overlap checks turn red in the real app.
prevention.strategy: Move the panel onto AnchoredPopover; replace the flex/nowrap rows with a wrap-safe two-column grid; flow sections with CSS columns so height stays within the minimum window.

legacy_paths.rationale: The in-place absolute panel and its own pointerdown/Escape listeners are replaced by AnchoredPopover's dismissal in the same change.

residual_risks: The node composer can still be covered by the floating Agent dock; that is the separate composer/bottom-dock fix on fix/composer-overlap-and-dropped-keys-20260921.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 「谁在最上面」只归 overlayLayers/AnchoredPopover 管；帮助面板只负责用它。结构测试钉死不许再回到原地 absolute + 局部 z-index。
